notes:
Lettering drawn as a noise — KRAAAA, DOKI DOKI, GOGOGOGO — now has a voice of its own: the deepest one, read slowly, so it lands as weight rather than as a word being pronounced. These used to be skipped in silence. Settings › Voice has a switch if you'd rather they stayed that way.

An honest note, because you'll notice. On Infinite Gacha and Solo Leveling this almost never fires yet. The effects ARE on the page and the recogniser does reach them — it just can't read stylised lettering, so "chatter chatter" comes back as "hatter atfer" and "SNAPS AWAKE" as "Snas". Reading those aloud would be gibberish, so the voice waits for the words. The gap is the recogniser, not the narrator, and that's the next thing.

Chapters you've already read will re-read their pages once to pick this up.
